description: Run a deep strategy analysis for a single app from SGE apps_videos (viral-only sample). Returns rich hook/format/length insights and evidence.

app_name.description: App name when App Store ID is unknown

app_store_id.description: App Store ID for the app to analyze

date_from.description: ISO start date. Defaults to last 60 days.

date_to.description: ISO end date. Defaults to now.

name: app_strategy

accounts.description: Social accounts SGE tracks posting about this app.

url.description: Link to the article on Social Growth Engineers.

notes.description: SGE growth notes from app_strategy; empty for other tools.

label.description: What the note is about (Pattern, Hook, Format, Length or Creators).

pageUrl.description: Link to the app’s page on Social Growth Engineers.

similarity.description: Similarity to the query or source app, as a percentage (0–100); null for non-similarity searches.

videos.description: Short-form videos SGE tracks for this app.

views.description: Total views across the tracked videos.

kind.description: Panel type; always "apps" for this tool.

total.description: Total number of matching apps, which can exceed the number returned in apps.

title: Analyze App Video Strategy
